budgetFormula.acceptanceUse: For an otherwise equivalent candidate cohort, candidate p95 must not exceed its frozen upper limit. Apply separately by platform and finished-history count to the same metric.
budgetFormula.medianAbsoluteDeviation: Median of absolute differences from the sample median.
budgetFormula.nearestRankP95: Sorted value at index ceil(0.95*n)-1; for n=7 this is the maximum.

environment.note: Backend binary hashes differ between runner invocations because the Makefile embeds build time; each frozen condition cohort uses one exact binary hash.

limitations: SQLite rows scanned, joined, or enriched are not observable at the permitted test-only fixture boundary; the harness records returned rows and browser-store materialization only.
CDP ScriptDuration and TaskDuration are broad renderer deltas over sampled interactions, not isolated ordinary-session reconciliation time.
Delayed task-session identity arrives naturally on desktop saved-layout reload; no controlled response-delay test seam was added.
Phone layout has no desktop dockview maximize state; phone child navigation is measured with the native drawer and open/Back loops.
The failed phone 1000 run is retained as evidence and excluded only from numeric successful-sample distributions; a seven-run same-binary cohort exists separately.
The aggregate encoded HTTP body byte count includes a cached mock-agent logo response reported by Playwright as -378 bytes; decoded body totals and the large target routes are recorded separately.

phoneFullMatrix.failure: Playwright test timeout at 240000ms; finally-block CDP detach reported a closed page and masked the awaited operation. Backend log contains state-read deadlines and an empty queued message against a fixture task with no executor. The root awaited operation was not captured.

seedRecipe.finishedPayload: Each delivered child has 5 repeated objective sentences and 19 repeated result sentences.
seedRecipe.mixedTask: 3 ordinary siblings plus one terminal-pending result and one recovery-attention control, followed by the finished delivered children.
seedRecipe.ordinaryControlTask: 3 ordinary siblings and no Errand rows.
